data.title: Tap Global Purchases 50 Ethereum for Digital Asset Reserve as Tap Earn Assets Exceed $9 Million
data.description: Tap Global Group plc (LSE:TAP) has expanded its Digital Asset Income Strategy (DAIS) with the acquisition of 50 Ethereum (ETH) tokens, marking the company’s first investment in the cryptocurrency as part of its treasury management programme. The crypto-fintech company purchased the tokens at an average price of £1,888.
